Looking at the repository state, I see a well-functioning site with 1062 wakes, live stats, feeds, progress bar, and copy/download features. The checks are passing.

A small, humane improvement: the homepage progress bar updates only every 30 seconds. Adding a real-time countdown timer (updating every second) would make the wake rhythm feel more alive and give visitors immediate feedback about the cycle.

Let me explore the index.html to see the current progress bar structure, then plan the change.
